Ah! Geez, familiar, why are you yawning?!
Pull yourself together!!

(Is it because I beat those annoying jerks?
...No, it's not just that—)

Besides, if you guys buy too much,
there won't be any left for me! Use your head for once!!

(I'll win... I'm gonna win!!
I'll crush every single one of them!!)

I explained the rules while subtly placing myself between Sweep Tosho and the Umamusume
to ensure things wouldn't turn physical.

Without a word in reply, the Umamusume headed toward the gate.
Right before seeing Sweep Tosho off, I gave her one final piece of advice.

Her total refusal to listen was likely rooted in a deep-seated distrust
toward authority figures that had built up over time.
No means no!! Noooo waaaaay!!

Hah, figures, you're just a brat! Too slow, way too slow!!
See ya at the finish line~!!

...Hmph, well, I guess I wouldn't mind drinking some.
But no way am I standing in line. You go buy it!
(...Ah. Come to think of it, back in the beginning too—)
(Huh? Wait... did that just feel... amazing?)
The strongest one here... is meeeeeeeeee!!

Haah, haah, haah, haah...
The final stretch...!!

And so began my life as Sweep Tosho's "familiar"—or rather,
her dedicated trainer—in search of the magic in racing, but...

A weird hat, you say?!
My precious proof of being a magical girl from Grandma... is WEIRD, you say?!!
Hah?! You're on, runt!!
Whoa~! That got me totally hyped...!!

That's it, I've had it with you!! Race me right now!!
I'll make you realize which one of us needs to shut up and listen!!

Two well-built Umamusume, seemingly high schoolers,
began arguing with the clerk! The air around them instantly grew tense...!
No, no, no! I don't even want to look at the track today!!

Some days I would wait beside her for hours until she felt like moving,
while other days—

Wait, familiar? Are you swaying on your feet?
...Hey?
...Huh?

Huh? Even in the middle of a race?
You know you'd be lucky to get away with just major injuries, right? That kind of—
Like I said, I'm buying for my friends too, so I need five!

The moment the tension snapped, all the built-up exhaustion
hit me at once—and before I knew it, I had blacked out.

After settling things with the other Umamusume, who were now full of remorse,
I called out to Sweep Tosho. ...That was a magnificent run.

No. I don't want to run on woodchips today.
I'm just not in the mood.
"Magic"...

"Make us realize who needs to shut up and listen," was it?
Ridiculous!!

Honestly, the situation wasn't looking great. At this rate,
venturing into the racing world to find magic seemed like an impossible dream.
Ugh?! N-No waaaay...!

(Nnngh... I was gonna win even without you saying so!
Like I'd ever lose to annoying jerks like them!!)

Don't be so damn stingy!
We're paying customers, ya know?! Hey!!

Wait... Familiar?! !!
Idiot, answer me!! ...Hey, say something—!!

I-I'm very sorry, but the "Fresh Raw Hachimii" is in limited supply,
so we ask that each customer purchase a maximum of two...

Whoa, what was that?!
She blew past them at ridiculous speed in the final stretch!!

...Hah? What's with this runt?
Wearing a weird hat and all. Mind your own business.

We managed to borrow a track at a freestyle racecourse,
where amateur Umamusume hold unofficial racing meets.
Just then—

Hmm, "Limited Edition Fresh Raw Hachimii Drink"?
Well... that does look pretty tasty.

All the fatigue caught up to me and I let out a sudden yawn.
After getting scolded with a pout, I joined the line with a wry smile—
Are you completely stupid?!
(Thud...)

It says "Up to 2 per person" right there on the banner!!
Can't you read letters that big?! Are you blind?!

I mustered my courage and stepped between the volatile Umamusume.
Defusing the situation peacefully seemed unlikely, but at the very least—!!
Haah, haah... Whew...
Desperately calming down the girls who looked ready to sprint off any second—

(...What was that earlier? As if to say
I'd definitely win if nothing went wrong—)
And with that, the race began—
—So, I brought Sweep Tosho out for a change of pace.
(WOOOOOOAAAHHH!!)

Still, earning trust takes time. For a while,
I spent every waking hour struggling on Sweep Tosho's behalf.

Because of the limited quantity, the line was insanely long.
Figuring there was no helping it, I waited for the line to move forward, when—
